name: Cloth Hero
tagline: A landing-page hero where your picture becomes real cloth — vinyl, curtains, beads or silk — that ripples under the cursor.
youSay: /cloth-hero A silk scarf brand called Mare: the koi scarf streaming under water, calm and luxurious
whatYouGet: A landing-page hero with real-time cloth physics: a sheet you pull, panels you walk through, a bead curtain or a banner in a current
Your picture on the cloth, baked into the material: a print on vinyl, dye in linen, one bead per pixel, a silk print
The page around it: brand, headline, copy, details, fonts, palette, synthesised sound, and layouts for desktop and phone
A static site (HTML, CSS, JS and three.js) you can host anywhere
goodFit: Fashion, textiles, jewellery, hospitality and craft brands
Launches and campaigns built around one striking picture
notFor: Pages that must work without WebGL
Long scrolling pages or online shops
youBring: What the page is for, and a picture if you have one
Optional: the kind of cloth, brand name, colours and tone
needs: Skillsmart credits for generated pictures (about 40–60 per page; none with your own)

generates.estimate: about 40–60 per page, none with your own pictures
